'''Reagal Eron''' served as the [[Adjutant/Legends|adjutant]] to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Isis (Governor)|Isis]]. At some point after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Eron was present in Isis's office when the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] brought the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Feldrall Okor]] to Isis, whom the governor had put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on. Eron and the others in the office were petrified when Fett activated a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]], demanding a larger sum of money. Isis eventually conceded to paying the bounty and Fett deactivated the detonator. The incident caused Eron to request a reassignment to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Eron went on to serve as the [[Chief gunnery officer/Legends|chief gunnery officer]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Eradicator (Imperial-class)|''Eradicator'']], and at some point related the story of the incident between Fett and Isis.
